repos.notes: Last commit 2026-09-06 (git log). VID:PID 0x16d0:0x116d used by ALL Machdyne ECP5 boards (per-board boardinfo.vh BOARD_VID/BOARD_PID, e.g. boards/lakritz/boardinfo.vh) - confirms the guide's downstream citation directly in this upstream source. Flash layout has BOTH variants coexisting here: 1MB boot region / 0x100000 user start on kaugummi, klinge, konfekt, kopflos, minze, schoko; 256KB boot / 0x040000 user start on lakritz and obst (boardinfo.vh comment: sized to twice the compressed bootloader; "KEEP USERPART_START AND BOOTADDR IN THIS BOARD'S Makefile IN SYNC"); kuchen/riegel use a third, ~132KB-boot/163840-user layout. repos.toolchain: unknown (no build script/toolchain arg in this repo; imports external migen.build.platforms.versaecp55g platform, typically yosys+nextpnr-ecp5 via Migen Builder, unverified here).
